summary: A compact-filter length that overflows the cursor aborts the parser
details: decode_cfilter added the decoded filter length to the payload cursor. A length of u64::MAX overflowed that addition and aborted the process. The node fuzz target node_p2p_allowed_frames on freeze commit 36bb40c exited 77 at 2026-11-13T16:04:43Z. The 50-byte input is sha256 261a963679bb2e62b769a8fb6565a67a02068dca3f53a1cdbcd32c374ec399f9. This is a parser panic, not a consensus-rule change. origin/main fixed it in 9096b8414777f8718de1264ba9ac81dcd00d1dfc by using checked_add. Tag v0.1.92 does not contain that commit. Local stability/beta-gate cherry-picked it as 5d8915a7c7417dd116fd4f7f4201323a70c0c338. On that commit, cfilter_length_does_not_overflow passed: 1 passed, 2035 filtered out. No release tag contains the fix, so the advisory stays open. Reporter credit is blank pending consent.
